title: Activate a license
summary: The Activate a license dialog over Priya's Library at its Enter step: the account the key will join first (avatar, name, email, Not you?), the key field (visible, mono, Paste), and under it the product the key is for before anything activates; Continue leads to the confirm step.
compare: The account row comes first (portal-26, B12): who the key joins, with Not you?
The key is visible and mono (never masked), middle-truncated at rest, with Paste; once it parses, 'Key for DJDL · Studio' previews under it with the product's icon (PORTAL §4.17).
Inline errors at the field (§4.19): not a key, a key for another product, already in this library, used up; each says what to do.
Continue (ink) goes to portal.activate-confirm; Cancel is a ghost; the dialog head has the core violet rule and no glyph.
Phone: a bottom sheet with Continue pinned; the bottom bar's Activate opens it.
